text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- Vietnam's National Assembly has approved eight new ministers.
-- State Bank Governor Cao Sy Kiem has told the National Assembly that Vietnam lacks medium and long-term investment, while short-term investment is surpassing demand.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has asked the National Assembly's Standing committee to issue a special ordinance soon to combat corruption.
-- The Bank for Industry and Commerce of Vietnam has increased interest rates on savings accounts, but rates for short and medium-term loans are unchanged.
-- Prime Minister Vo Van Kiet has told Burma's visiting Education Minister he is pleased with the development of relations between the two countries.
